# PerfPilot API

<!-- Generated by scripts/export_openapi.py from the FastAPI app. Do not edit by hand;
     run `make openapi` after changing routes. -->

Version 0.1.0. The machine-readable contract is [`openapi.json`](openapi.json); a running API also serves it at `/openapi.json` with interactive docs at `/docs`.

Conventions:

- All routes are under `/api`. Long-running work returns **202** with a `JobAccepted` body (`job_id`, `subject_type`, `subject_id`); poll `GET /api/jobs/{job_id}`.
- Errors use one envelope: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`. Request validation failures are `422 request_validation_error`.
- Request bodies are capped (`PERFPILOT_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES`, ZIP uploads `PERFPILOT_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES`) → `413 limit_exceeded`. List endpoints take bounded `limit`/`offset` parameters.
- Every result carries a provenance label: `MEASURED`, `STATIC` or `AI_HYPOTHESIS`.
- There is no authentication: the API is meant to listen on localhost only (see [security.md](security.md)).

## Repository audit (primary workflow)

Import a repository, run a static audit (never executes code), optionally add AI recommendations and an approved runtime audit in the sandbox, then export reports.

### repositories

| Method | Path | Query | Returns | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/import/options` |  | 200 `ImportOptionsOut` | Import Options |
| GET | `/api/repositories` | `limit` | 200 list[RepositoryOut] | List Repositories |
| POST | `/api/repositories` |  | 202 `JobAccepted` — async job | Import a public GitHub repository or an allowlisted local directory |
| POST | `/api/repositories/upload` |  | 202 `JobAccepted` — async job | Import a repository from a ZIP archive (multipart field 'file') |
| GET | `/api/repositories/{repository_id}` |  | 200 `RepositoryDetailOut` | Get Repository |
| GET | `/api/snapshots/{snapshot_id}` |  | 200 `SnapshotSummary` | Get Snapshot |
| GET | `/api/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/files` | `language`, `python_only`, `include_skipped` | 200 `FileListOut` | List Snapshot Files |
| GET | `/api/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/files/content` | `path` | 200 `FileContentOut` | Get Snapshot File Content |

| GET | `/api/workloads/{workload_id}` |  | 200 `WorkloadDetailOut` | Get Workload |
